name: In The Cape Electric
address: 1232 Viscaya Pkwy, Cape Coral, FL 33990, United States

reviewSamples.author: Don Gardner
reviewSamples.text: Highly recommend! Needed some electrical installed at our dock and Dan was very professional from start to finish. Upfront reasonable pricing and was able to complete the job quickly. Thanks again!

reviewSamples.author: Tim Hill
reviewSamples.text: ITC (In The Cape Electric) added a generator back feed and additional 20amp circuit for us. Great price. Excellent and efficient job. I highly recommend Dan and his crew !

reviewSamples.author: Janet Gordon
reviewSamples.text: We had a major electrical emergency on a holiday. This company agreed to do the work and it was completed in a timely manner. The owner secured the emergency permit and worked for hours trying to get the power company to do their part. All is well now and we are grateful for Mike's professionalism and determination.

reviewSamples.author: wyatt alm
reviewSamples.text: Hired in the cape to do some electrical work in my house. They were very fast to respond and came right out. Very professional and a pleasure to deal with. Highly recommend

reviewSamples.author: kiley newcomb
reviewSamples.text: They are great. Rewired my bathroom and trouble shooted a faulty breaker in my barn. They came out asap as my horses had no cooling fans in this heat. Highly recommend!!!! Thank you guys!
